## Talk Slides

This is a site for slides from talks I have given, or plan to give.

### FOSS:4G Leeds (2026-10-13)

The talk details [A Fully Automated Luxury Global Public Transport Network](https://talks.osgeo.org/foss4g-uk-2026/talk/MLXEFE/)

::: {#fig-service-count}
{{< video https://github.com/anisotropi4/shed/releases/download/1.0.2/2026-08-17-10-all-007-06-s.mp4?raw=true
    title="Aggregated passenger seat, carriage and service week of 2026-08-17"

Passenger Seat, Carriage and Service Count week 2026-08-17  
:::

Leeds is a friendly, diverse, international city.
But getting here can be awkward.
If you were going to build a global high-speed transport network to serve the needs of the students and workers of the People's Republic of West Yorkshire, what would it look like?

The talk slides for [A Fully Automated Luxury Global Public Transport Network](Vortrag/Leeds-20261013-final.pdf).
